verdict.rationale: SES documents an AWS Free Tier of up to 3,000 free message charges per month for the first 12 months. However, new accounts start in a sandbox that can only send to verified identities. Reaching real users requires a separate production-access request, so free validation with real users depends on approval. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that free-tier allowances apply after production access, sandbox-free real delivery from day one, a free tier that does not expire after 12 months, and independent corroboration of the free-tier onboarding experience.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo

citations.quote: New customers can send emails for free through Amazon SES using the AWS Free Tier ... Receive up to 3,000 message charges for free each month for the first 12 months after you start using SES.
When your account is in the sandbox, you can only send email to verified identities.
When your account has moved out of the sandbox and into production, you can send email to any recipient, regardless of whether the recipient's address or domain is verified.
While your account is in the sandbox, you can use all of the features of Amazon SES.
